description: Header file defining utilities and configurations for testing the SbPlayer component in the starboard namespace, including test config structures, function declarations for creating and writing to players, and support checks.

classes.name: SbPlayerTestConfig
classes.description: Structure holding configuration parameters for SbPlayer tests, including filenames, output mode, key system, and max video capabilities.

methods.name: GetAudioTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of audio test filenames.

methods.name: GetVideoTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of video test filenames.

methods.name: GetPlayerOutputModes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported SbPlayer output modes.

methods.name: GetKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of key system identifiers.

methods.name: GetSupportedSbPlayerTestConfigs
methods.description: Generates a list of supported SbPlayer test configurations, optionally filtered by key system.

methods.name: GetSbPlayerTestConfigName
methods.description: Returns a string name for a given test configuration.

methods.name: DummyDecoderStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for decoder status updates.

methods.name: DummyPlayerStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for player status updates.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerCreate
methods.description: Creates an SbPlayer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes samples to the SbPlayer from a VideoDmpReader.

methods.name: IsOutputModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific output mode is supported with given codecs and key system.

methods.name: IsPartialAudioSupported
methods.description: Checks if partial audio is supported.

methods.name: IsAudioPassthroughUsed
methods.description: Determines if audio passthrough is used based on the test configuration.
